payload.question: Is the council collecting the business rates it is owed?
payload.label: Business rates collected against target, Q1 2025/26

target.display: 100% of the amount due by this point

payload.council_caveat: The council explains the spike: "a large payment for a new warehouse and a backdated retail relief. There are also a number of accounts that pay the full year in April which front-loads income into the first quarter." The council publishes these numbers as screenshots of a dashboard inside a PDF, so they cannot be read by machine. We read them off the images by eye, which is why this measure is flagged for human checking.
payload.evidence: Same idea as council tax: a 100% target, a 99% intervention level, and 111.24% collected in the first quarter of 2025/26.
